correctness.rationale: Two independent enumeration domains were reconstructed. Direct labeled enumeration gives zero inefficient profiles for \(n\le3\) and exactly 68,976 for \(n=4\), and every detected cycle has a reciprocal 2-cycle. An anonymous-multiset enumeration gives 3,270 inefficient multisets; weighting by agent-label multiplicities returns 68,976. Quotienting by object relabeling gives exactly 762 total classes and 153 inefficient classes, with orbit-size distribution \(72^4,144^3,288^{55},576^{91}\) in count notation and multiplicity-pattern counts 119 of type \(1+1+1+1\), 30 of type \(2+1+1\), and four of type \(2+2\). The four canonical two-order classes were independently recovered. Bogomolnaia-Moulin Lemma 3 supplies the exact acyclicity test used.
correctness.risk: All classification statements are finite and exhaustively checked; the main residual correctness risk is implementation mismatch, mitigated by two distinct enumeration domains and exact reconstruction identities.

value.rationale: This is the exact first nontrivial boundary of RSD ordinal inefficiency. The universal 2-cycle collapse and complete symmetry taxonomy explain the geometry of every four-agent counterexample, while the four minimal two-order classes isolate the simplest mechanisms producing inefficiency. Those are motivated structural refinements, not just a repeated raw count.
value.risk: The result remains a finite small-market classification; its value is structural completeness at the first boundary.

final_claim: For four agents and four objects with strict preferences, random serial dictatorship is ordinally inefficient on exactly 68,976 of the 331,776 labeled profiles. Modulo agent and object relabeling there are exactly 762 profile classes, of which 153 are inefficient; their orbit sizes are distributed as four classes of size 72, three of size 144, 55 of size 288, and 91 of size 576. Every inefficient class already has a directed 2-cycle in the Bogomolnaia-Moulin relation. The minimum number of distinct preference orders in an inefficient profile is two, and exactly four symmetry classes attain that minimum, all with multiplicity pattern \(2+2\).
limitations: The 68,976 labeled total overlaps the companion RP/PS census; originality rests on the quotient, orbit, 2-cycle, and minimal-preference refinements.
